correctness.rationale: De Finetti reduces the parity bias to E[M^n] for M in [-1,1] with fixed mean. For even n, convexity gives the lower envelope and endpoint mixing gives the upper envelope. For odd n, the unique tangent-through-(1,1) construction is shown to be the least concave majorant, and odd symmetry gives the greatest convex minorant. Explicit one- or two-atom measures attain every boundary piece.

value.rationale: Parity is a canonical high-order nonmonotone statistic. The theorem completely classifies its feasible probability under infinite exchangeability with only a marginal constraint, gives explicit finite-sample extremizers, and reveals a sharp even/odd phase split with the nontrivial fair-marginal odd limit [1/4,3/4].
